A triangle is bounded by y=0, y=6−x/2 and a perpendicular through origin. Find its area.
A triangle is bounded by x=0, y=8−2x and the perpendicular line through origin. Calculate its area.
A parallelogram is bounded by y=0, y=3, y=2x, and the parallel line passing through (4,1). Find its exact area.

When does a linear model P(t)=46020+3025t from 2010 first attain 75000?

For five-year population model P(t)=75000+2500t with 0≤t≤5, give domain and range.
For P(t)=75000+2500t, interpret intercepts and whether negative-time x-intercept is physically meaningful.
Explain the slope in P(t)=75000+2500t.

A newborn begins at 7.5 lb and gains 0.5 lb/month. Construct model for its first 12 months.
For W(t)=7.5+0.5t during the first year, give domain and range.
For W(t)=7.5+0.5t, describe intercepts and physical relevance.
What does slope 0.5 mean for W(t)=7.5+0.5t?
At what age does model W(t)=7.5+0.5t predict 10.4 lb?
Estimate newborn weight W(6.2) from W(t)=7.5+0.5t and state units.
A health service counted 12025 cases in 2005, decreasing linearly by 205 per year until 2010. Model cases versus t years from 2005.
Find domain and range for C(t)=12025−205t during calendar years 2005 through 2010.
For C(t)=12025−205t, what are the intercepts and which is meaningful within 2005–2010?
Interpret the slope −205 in C(t)=12025−205t.
Extrapolate C(t)=12025−205t to zero cases; explain why the result is outside observed domain.
When would extrapolated C(t)=12025−205t reach 9700 cases?
An independent labelled graph shows company profit y(t)=120+2t thousand dollars, t years since 1980. Determine its linear rule from at least two plotted coordinates.
An independent labelled graph shows company profit y(t)=120+2t thousand dollars, t years since 1980. Find and interpret its original y-intercept.
An independent labelled graph shows company profit y(t)=120+2t thousand dollars, t years since 1980. Find and interpret the x-intercept, with horizon caveat.
An independent labelled graph shows company profit y(t)=120+2t thousand dollars, t years since 1980. Find and interpret its annual slope.

Mississippi median home value $25200 in 1950 and $71400 in 2000. Estimate 2010 by linear extrapolation.
When would historical straight-line Mississippi ($25200→$71400) and Hawaii ($74400→$272700) home values meet, using dates 1950 and 2000?
Indiana home values $37700→$94300; Alabama $27100→$85100 from 1950 to 2000. Which increased faster?
Project Indiana median home value $37700 in 1950 and $94300 in 2000 into 2010 using same linear trend.
Under historic linear trends, find year when Indiana ($37700→$94300) and Alabama ($27100→$85100) would coincide.

An independently phrased school/town case shows population 1001 in 2004 and 1697 in 2008. (a) Find the absolute growth, (b) elapsed years, (c) yearly rate, (d) population in 2000, (e) model P(t) for t years after 2000, (f) predict population in 2011 assuming unchanged slope.

An independently phrased school/town case shows population 1431 in 2003 and 2134 in 2007. (a) Find the absolute growth, (b) elapsed years, (c) yearly rate, (d) population in 2000, (e) model P(t) for t years after 2000, (f) predict population in 2014 assuming unchanged slope.
A mobile plan costs $71.50 for 410 minutes and $118 for 720 minutes. (a) Fit C(m), (b) explain monthly fixed charge and rate, (c) calculate C(687).
Mobile data costs $10 baseline plus a variable charge; 20 MB costs $11.20 and 130 MB costs $17.80. (a) Fit rule, (b) interpret rate and baseline, (c) calculate 250 MB.
Moose count grew from 4360 in 1991 to 5880 in 1999. (a) Find the linear model with t=years since 1990 and (b) forecast 2003.
Owls decline from 340 in 2003 to 285 in 2007. (a) Fit model t years since 2003; (b) forecast 2012.
A gas reserve contains 16 billion cubic feet in 2010, depleted by 2.1 billion/year. (a) Model t years since 2010, (b) evaluate 2015, (c) predict empty time.
An oil reserve has 1820 billion barrels in 2014 and declines 25 billion/year. (a) Model t years after 2014; (b) seven-year reserve; (c) estimated depletion time.
